checked_sources: independent_checks.py: Independent full 2^16-state vectorized state transition and functional-graph census for both graphs, including per-depth population and consensus basins.
correctness.rationale: Both 16-vertex degree-six graphs were independently generated directly from rook coordinate agreement and Shrikhande Cayley differences ±(1,0),±(0,1),±(1,1); adjacency common neighbor count two confirms SRG parameters, while rook has eight four-cliques and Shrikhande none. For a binary state x, each site updates to one when ≥4 of six neighbors are one, zero when ≤2, and keeps x_v when exactly 3. Independent direct all-65536-state successor arrays (not read from repository verifier) were decomposed into cycles and predecessor basins; complete values: rook (fixed 302, 2-cycles 1197, periodic states 2696, max t=3, consensus basin each 20789), Shrikhande (142,685,1512,5,28221), entry histograms [2696,14136,29984,18720] and [1512,9304,26240,18496,9024,960]. Both finite-domain iterate identities F_R^5=F_R^3 and F_S^7=F_S^5 were exhaustively checked. Thus this is a complete exact finite census, not an extrapolated sample; all counts are for labeled configurations.
residual_risks: Finite tests alone do not prove infinite claims; source proof reconstructed and critical steps checked analytically.
